ensalada-quinoa.name: Quinoa Salad
ensalada-quinoa.description: Nutritious salad with quinoa, avocado and fresh vegetables. Rich in complete proteins, fiber and healthy fats. Perfect for vegans.

step1.title: Rinse the quinoa
step1.description: Measure 200g of quinoa and rinse in a fine mesh strainer under cold water for 2 minutes to remove saponins.
step1.tip: This step removes the natural bitter taste of quinoa.

step2.title: Cook the quinoa
step2.description: In a medium pot, boil 480ml of water with a pinch of salt. Add quinoa, reduce to medium-low heat and cook covered for 15 minutes.
step2.tip: Quinoa is ready when the grains become translucent and you see a small white spiral.

step3.title: Cool the quinoa
step3.description: Once cooked, remove from heat, uncover and let cool to room temperature for 10 minutes. Fluff with a fork.

step4.title: Prepare the vegetables
step4.description: While quinoa cools, wash and cut cherry tomatoes in half. Peel and cut avocado into medium cubes.

step5.title: Mix ingredients
step5.description: In a large bowl, combine cooled quinoa, cherry tomatoes and avocado. Mix gently to avoid mashing the avocado.

step6.title: Serve
step6.description: Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 2 days. Can be accompanied with a drizzle of lemon and olive oil.
step6.tip: Add avocado just before serving if storing the salad to prevent oxidation.

ensalada-quinoa.history1: Quinoa, considered a 'supergrain', was first cultivated over 5,000 years ago in the Andes. The Incas called it 'mother grain' and considered it sacred. Unlike other grains, quinoa is a complete protein, containing all 9 essential amino acids. It's ideal for vegan and vegetarian diets.
ensalada-quinoa.seo-title: Quinoa Salad with Avocado - High Protein Vegan Recipe
ensalada-quinoa.seo-description: Fresh quinoa salad with avocado and cherry tomatoes. Complete protein, high fiber and ready in 25 minutes. Vegan and gluten-free recipe.
